subject.title: [Feature]: Bundled RCS channel (Twilio) as a sibling to the sms channel

question: Should Twilio RCS receive bundled OpenClaw ownership alongside SMS, or should the existing implementation ship as an external channel plugin?
rationale: Repository policy, public SDK coverage, and the SMS package’s current distribution model favor an external plugin, but carrier auto-upgrade and shared phone-number operations present a plausible exception requiring an explicit long-term ownership commitment.

options.title: Publish external plugin
options.body: Move the implementation to an independently maintained npm and ClawHub package using the existing public channel SDK.

options.title: Sponsor bundled RCS
options.body: Keep the paired PR in core, assign long-term ownership, and require live provider, security, and upgrade proof before landing.

recommendation.title: Publish external plugin
recommendation.body: Move the implementation to an independently maintained npm and ClawHub package using the existing public channel SDK.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the Twilio SMS channel whose ownership and distribution tier the request seeks to extend.
